_comment: Quality debt baseline -- the ratchet. CI fails if a number gets WORSE.
These values may only ever be edited DOWNWARD. If a PR needs to raise
one, that is the discussion, not a silent edit.
Regenerate the measurement with: npm run lint:report

eslint._rebaseNote: 975 -> 982 is a REBASE, not new debt. Adding src/test and vitest.config.ts to tsconfig's include broadened the type-aware program, so no-misused-promises (+7) now resolves in pre-existing app files it previously could not type -- all 151 occurrences are in app code (EncounterPage 14, DmCharacterViewPage 12, CharacterViewPage 11, ...). The three test files contribute zero warnings. Verified by measuring with the old include (984) and the new one (982).
eslint._ratchetNote: 957 -> 920 (2026-10-25). ActionPanel (76 warnings, 1250 lines) decomposed into ./stage; the rolls return their promises and are explicitly voided at call sites, and string-keyed lookup tables are typed Partial, retiring floating-promise and unnecessary-condition warnings.

duplication._comment: Enforced via `jscpd --threshold`. Rose from 1.52% when 633 lines of non-duplicated dead code were deleted, shrinking the denominator.

knip._comment: files + dependencies are BLOCKING (npm run knip:strict). unusedExports is reported only -- dnd5eApi.ts is an API-client surface where an unused export is a weak signal.

tests._comment: Unit + component via vitest; part of `npm run quality`.
